rules.description: Corridors and hallways must meet a minimum clear width to allow egress and accessibility.
Door clear opening width must meet accessibility minimums. Placeholder — actual door geometry not yet modelled.
Every floor must have an accessible egress path. At least one room should function as or connect to an exit corridor.
Bathrooms serving bedrooms should be accessible from sleeping areas without crossing through another bedroom or kitchen.
Stairs or landing areas, if present, should have a minimum run/landing depth. Placeholder — stair geometry not yet modelled.
